The best morning train from New Delhi (NDLS) to Agra Cantt is the 12002 Shatabdi Express: Daily, leaves 6:00 AM, arrives 7:50 AM, 1 hr 50 min.

Other morning trains from New Delhi:

12138 Punjab Mail: Daily, 5:10 AM to 8:10 AM (3 hr)
18514 / 20808 Hirakund Express: 8:15 AM to 10:35 AM (2 hr 20 min)
11906 HSX AGC Express: Daily, 7:20 AM to 11:00 AM (3 hr 40 min)
64074 EMU: Daily, 4:15 AM to 9:05 AM (4 hr 50 min)

If Hazrat Nizamuddin (NZM) works for you, the 22470 Vande Bharat (6:00 AM to 7:40 AM) and 12050 Gatimaan Express (8:10 AM to 9:50 AM) are fastest at 1 hr 40 min. Their running days and seat availability are not confirmed.

This list is for Thu 12 Nov, and today's morning trains have already left. It came from a web page, not IRCTC, which blocked me, and the page was cut off after 11:20 AM. Check running days and seats on IRCTC before you plan around any of these.
